title: Mostly Shipshape
story: Felix gave four sailing lessons on Saturday morning, one on the hour, each in a different little boat from his yard. He kept the lesson sheet in his head, which he calls shipshape. It is mostly shipshape. Every student is owed a certificate naming the boat and the hour, so who sailed when, and in which boat?

cats.label: Time
cats.either: had either the {a} or the {b} lesson
cats.nor: had neither the {a} nor the {b} lesson

texts: The Ripple's sailor had a later lesson than the Tern's sailor.
Pearl had an earlier lesson than the Tern's sailor.
Emil had a later lesson than the Bluebell's sailor.
Walt had either the 9 a.m. or the 11 a.m. lesson.
The Bluebell's sailor is neither Emil nor Pearl.
The Bluebell's sailor had either the 10 a.m. or the noon lesson.

trace.text: Clue 4 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 6 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Clue 1 means the Ripple cannot be 9 a.m. and the Tern cannot be noon.
Since the Tern can still be only 9 a.m., 10 a.m., or 11 a.m., clue 2 means Pearl cannot be 11 a.m. or noon and the Tern cannot be 9 a.m.
9 a.m. must go with the Whelk: clue 2 rules out the Tern; clue 6 rules out the Bluebell; clue 1 rules out the Ripple.
Since the Ripple can still be only 10 a.m., 11 a.m., or noon and the Tern can still be only 10 a.m. or 11 a.m., clue 1 means the Ripple cannot be 10 a.m.
Since the Bluebell can still be only 10 a.m. or noon, clue 3 means Emil cannot be 9 a.m. or 10 a.m. and the Bluebell cannot be noon.
The Bluebell must go with 10 a.m.: clue 6 rules out 9 a.m. and 11 a.m.; clue 3 rules out noon.
The Tern must go with 11 a.m.: clue 2 rules out 9 a.m.; clue 1 rules out noon; 10 a.m. already goes with the Bluebell.
The Ripple must go with noon: clue 1 rules out 9 a.m. and 10 a.m.; 11 a.m. already goes with the Tern.
The Bluebell must go with Carmen: clue 5 rules out Emil and Pearl; Walt is already ruled out for 10 a.m.
10 a.m. goes with the Bluebell, so 10 a.m. also goes with Carmen.
Pearl must go with 9 a.m.: clue 2 rules out 11 a.m. and noon; 10 a.m. already goes with Carmen.
Walt must go with 11 a.m.: clue 4 rules out 10 a.m. and noon; 9 a.m. already goes with Pearl.
Emil must go with noon: clue 3 rules out 9 a.m. and 10 a.m.; 11 a.m. already goes with Walt.
The Whelk must go with Pearl: Walt and Emil are already ruled out for 9 a.m.; Carmen already goes with the Bluebell.
The Tern goes with 11 a.m., so the Tern also goes with Walt.
Emil must go with the Ripple: clue 5 rules out the Bluebell; the Whelk is already ruled out for 9 a.m.; the Tern already goes with Walt.
